mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points over the prior month.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate decline below 4.5% indicates labor market tightening that boosts corporate hiring and consumer spending, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE is below 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in residential construction permits (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals robust consumer demand that increases corporate revenue visibility, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term has a negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: In early business cycle expansion, rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates improving manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO rises by at least 0.5% month-over-month during early expansion.

mechanism_narrative: Positive quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) indicates sustained economic expansion that supports corporate earnings, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth is positive.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI inflation rate above 2.5% signals persistent inflation that triggers Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL is above 2.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) and decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) indicates labor market strength that enhances consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint signal of PAYEMS rising and UNRATE falling fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances, or the interaction term has a negative coefficient with p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During monetary tightening cycles, a federal funds rate above 5.0% indicates restrictive policy that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is above 5.0% during a tightening cycle.
